Crimes - 2001 to Present (City of Chicago)

Crimes - 2001 to Present (City of Chicago)

Reported incidents of crime in the City of Chicago since 2001, from the Chicago Police Department CLEAR system, published on the Chicago Data Portal (Socrata) and updated daily. Not a survey: one row per incident.

Not yet reviewed by a person. The City of Chicago's Terms of Use (data disclaimer) say the City "voluntarily provides the data on this website as a service to the public", "as is", and may require a user "to terminate any and all display, distribution or other use" of the data. Anyone offering "any software application, or other secondary or derivative application using data supplied at this website" must include the City's disclaimer (quoted on that page) and comply with any additional terms of the agency providing the data. Users indemnify the City. The dataset's own description adds the Chicago Police Department's disclaimer, says the data "should not be used for comparison purposes over time", and prohibits attempts "to derive specific addresses". Nothing addresses LLM processing. The portal labels the license "See Terms of Use".
